question.text: REIT minimum public float (post listing) under SEBI REIT Regulations:

answer.text: At least 25% public holding post listing

explanation.text: The Logic: Under the SEBI REIT Regulations, a listed REIT is required to maintain a minimum public holding of 25% post listing. This public-float threshold supports trading liquidity and follows the broader listed-securities norms applied by SEBI to publicly traded units. The Trap: 'Nil' would mean no public-float requirement, which is inconsistent with a listed REIT structure. 50% and 100% overstate the minimum — SEBI sets a floor at 25%, not a majority public-holding requirement. Note: The 25% minimum public-holding figure is not stated in the cited NISM Series XXI-A PMS Distributors workbook REIT pages checked, which describe REIT structure, listing, liquidity, regulation, and types but do not quote a minimum public float. The framing above is presented as general regulatory knowledge of SEBI REIT Regulations rather than as a workbook citation.
